course.name: FDE Tech 职业进阶班
course.description: 面向已有 AI Engineering 能力、希望转向 FDE 的工程师，用多个客户案例训练商业判断、客户沟通与企业工程交付。
course.description_en: For engineers with AI Engineering experience moving towards FDE roles through business judgement, client communication and enterprise engineering delivery.
course.timeLength: 10 周；每周 3 小时工作坊，课外约 3–5 小时
course.cardDescription: FDE Tech 职业进阶班：10 周、30 项工程交付任务。从已有 AI Engineering 能力出发，练客户调查、方案与预算、系统接入、Evals、Pitch 和交接。
highlights: 预算、权限、评估与运行交接
course.courseObjective: 面对企业背景、预算和系统限制，独立调查问题、提出并验证解决方案，通过 Proposal、现场质询、方案修订和 Pitch 推动客户决定。
course.suitable: 能独立开发和调试 AI 应用，希望承担客户项目的工程师。
course.prerequisiteknowledge: 能独立运行、修改和解释自己的 AI 项目，理解 API、工具调用与基本评估。个别工具缺口可按需自学。

lessons.name: Enterprise Discovery & AI Opportunities
lessons.title: Enterprise Discovery & AI Opportunities
lessons.description: 工作坊：导师带着调查企业怎样完成一单业务，讲清部门、收入成本、系统和决策关系。学生还原流程，再接着提问。
lessons.description_en: Workshop: Observe a facilitator-led discovery, map how a company completes a service request, then ask follow-up questions.

learningMaterial.content:
Enterprise Discovery & AI Opportunities

导师带着调查企业怎样完成一单业务，讲清部门、收入成本、系统和决策关系。学生还原流程，再接着提问。

Preparation

Read the dispatch client packet and the mapped official resources. Bring the previous decision record and identify the evidence you still need. Use Claude or Codex for document, repository or test work when useful; inspect its output and record what you verified. Tool operation basics are self-study, not a substitute for the project work.

Client brief

Watch the facilitator interview the service coordinator. Reconstruct the enquiry-to-payment workflow, name each owner and identify missing information. Conduct follow-up discovery and explain one reason to defer automation.

Run of session

MinutesActivityInstructions
15Decision and business contextApprove the business problem, baseline and next investigation.
25Discovery and evidenceRead the dispatch client packet and the mapped official resources. Bring the previous decision record and identify the evidence you still need.
35Facilitated demonstrationWatch the facilitator interview the service coordinator. Reconstruct the enquiry-to-payment workflow, name each owner and identify missing information. Conduct follow-up discovery and explain one reason to defer automation.
60Implement and verifyProduce and verify: decision-and-evidence.md: Approve the business problem, baseline and next investigation.; project-artefacts/: Workflow, stakeholder map, evidence and unanswered questions.; revision-log.md: feedback, changes, evidence and individual contribution
30Review and next decisionPresent your work, respond to stakeholder questions and record the next decision: Approve the business problem, baseline and next investigation.
15Revision planRecord feedback, individual contribution and the next validation.

Submission

  • decision-and-evidence.md: Approve the business problem, baseline and next investigation.
  • project-artefacts/: Workflow, stakeholder map, evidence and unanswered questions.
  • revision-log.md: feedback, changes, evidence and individual contribution

Review criteria

  • Supports each decision with evidence and marks assumptions clearly.
  • Explains the impact on users, scope, full costs, controls and delivery.
  • Demonstrates the required work and identifies what was completed independently.

Decision to obtain

Approve the business problem, baseline and next investigation.

Knowledge check

What should you establish before proposing automation?

  • The business workflow, problem, baseline and decision owners.
  • Start by selecting an agent framework.
  • Automate the step that is easiest to implement.
Answer and reasoning

The business workflow, problem, baseline and decision owners.

The business workflow, problem, baseline and decision owners. The decision must be supported by the project evidence.

Reference reasoning

Use the case constraints and policy owners as authority. Approve the business problem, baseline and next investigation. Inspect the supporting artefacts and unresolved issues before granting approval.

lessons.name: AI Governance, Data & Security
lessons.title: AI Governance, Data & Security
lessons.description: 工作坊：进入第二个案例，学生按调查提纲访谈业务、IT 和安全负责人。核对数据主权、访问权限、审批与责任，修改方案和关键实现。
lessons.description_en: Workshop: Interview business, IT and security roles; turn data residency, access and approval requirements into design and implementation controls.

learningMaterial.content:
AI Governance, Data & Security

进入第二个案例，学生按调查提纲访谈业务、IT 和安全负责人。核对数据主权、访问权限、审批与责任，修改方案和关键实现。

Preparation

Read the knowledge client packet and the mapped official resources. Bring the previous decision record and identify the evidence you still need. Use Claude or Codex for document, repository or test work when useful; inspect its output and record what you verified. Tool operation basics are self-study, not a substitute for the project work.

Client brief

Investigate Knowledge Access using the discovery guide. Ask where data may be processed, who owns each document and which tools are permitted. Implement identity-aware retrieval and demonstrate that untrusted content cannot grant authority.

Run of session

MinutesActivityInstructions
15Decision and business contextApprove the data boundary and permitted operations.
25Discovery and evidenceRead the knowledge client packet and the mapped official resources. Bring the previous decision record and identify the evidence you still need.
35Guided investigationInvestigate Knowledge Access using the discovery guide. Ask where data may be processed, who owns each document and which tools are permitted. Implement identity-aware retrieval and demonstrate that untrusted content cannot grant authority.
60Implement and verifyProduce and verify: decision-and-evidence.md: Approve the data boundary and permitted operations.; project-artefacts/: Data flows, access controls, approvals and technical validation.; revision-log.md: feedback, changes, evidence and individual contribution
30Review and next decisionPresent your work, respond to stakeholder questions and record the next decision: Approve the data boundary and permitted operations.
15Revision planRecord feedback, individual contribution and the next validation.

Submission

  • decision-and-evidence.md: Approve the data boundary and permitted operations.
  • project-artefacts/: Data flows, access controls, approvals and technical validation.
  • revision-log.md: feedback, changes, evidence and individual contribution

Review criteria

  • Supports each decision with evidence and marks assumptions clearly.
  • Explains the impact on users, scope, full costs, controls and delivery.
  • Demonstrates the required work and identifies what was completed independently.

Decision to obtain

Approve the data boundary and permitted operations.

Knowledge check

How should data residency affect a solution?

  • Confirm permitted processing locations and enforce them in the design.
  • Choose a processing region after deployment.
  • Treat removal of names as approval for any region.
Answer and reasoning

Confirm permitted processing locations and enforce them in the design.

Confirm permitted processing locations and enforce them in the design. The decision must be supported by the project evidence.

Reference reasoning

Use the case constraints and policy owners as authority. Approve the data boundary and permitted operations. Inspect the supporting artefacts and unresolved issues before granting approval.

lessons.name: AI Evaluation & Reliability
lessons.title: AI Evaluation & Reliability
lessons.description: 工作坊：为第二个案例建立经业务核对的 golden dataset，区分开发与验收数据，检查错误、遗漏、引用和越权，再答辩是否值得试点。
lessons.description_en: Workshop: Build business-reviewed golden data, separate development and acceptance sets, analyse failures and defend the pilot decision.

learningMaterial.content:
AI Evaluation & Reliability

为第二个案例建立经业务核对的 golden dataset，区分开发与验收数据，检查错误、遗漏、引用和越权，再答辩是否值得试点。

Preparation

Read the knowledge client packet and the mapped official resources. Bring the previous decision record and identify the evidence you still need. Use Claude or Codex for document, repository or test work when useful; inspect its output and record what you verified. Tool operation basics are self-study, not a substitute for the project work.

Client brief

Define expected outcomes for normal, missing-evidence, stale-document and restricted-access inputs. Have the business role review the answers. Keep acceptance data separate, run the available checks and revise the proposal without claiming zero hallucinations.

Run of session

MinutesActivityInstructions
15Decision and business contextApprove, revise or stop the proposed pilot based on evidence.
25Discovery and evidenceRead the knowledge client packet and the mapped official resources. Bring the previous decision record and identify the evidence you still need.
35Guided investigationDefine expected outcomes for normal, missing-evidence, stale-document and restricted-access inputs. Have the business role review the answers. Keep acceptance data separate, run the available checks and revise the proposal without claiming zero hallucinations.
60Implement and verifyProduce and verify: decision-and-evidence.md: Approve, revise or stop the proposed pilot based on evidence.; project-artefacts/: Golden dataset, scoring criteria, failure analysis and revised proposal.; revision-log.md: feedback, changes, evidence and individual contribution
30Review and next decisionPresent your work, respond to stakeholder questions and record the next decision: Approve, revise or stop the proposed pilot based on evidence.
15Revision planRecord feedback, individual contribution and the next validation.

Submission

  • decision-and-evidence.md: Approve, revise or stop the proposed pilot based on evidence.
  • project-artefacts/: Golden dataset, scoring criteria, failure analysis and revised proposal.
  • revision-log.md: feedback, changes, evidence and individual contribution

Review criteria

  • Supports each decision with evidence and marks assumptions clearly.
  • Explains the impact on users, scope, full costs, controls and delivery.
  • Demonstrates the required work and identifies what was completed independently.

Decision to obtain

Approve, revise or stop the proposed pilot based on evidence.

Knowledge check

How should a golden dataset be used?

  • Agree expected outcomes with the business and keep separate acceptance data.
  • Tune against every acceptance item until all pass.
  • Let the generating model define all expected answers without business review.
Answer and reasoning

Agree expected outcomes with the business and keep separate acceptance data.

Agree expected outcomes with the business and keep separate acceptance data. The decision must be supported by the project evidence.

Reference reasoning

Use the case constraints and policy owners as authority. Approve, revise or stop the proposed pilot based on evidence. Inspect the supporting artefacts and unresolved issues before granting approval.

lessons.description_en: Practice: Own discovery for the main project and seek approval for the proposal, budget, acceptance criteria and milestones.

learningMaterial.content:
Client Discovery & Solution Proposal — Project Practice

启动完整项目，减少调查提示。学生决定找谁核实问题，独立提出方案、预算、验收标准和里程碑，争取客户批准。

Preparation

Read the procurement client packet and the mapped official resources. Bring the previous decision record and identify the evidence you still need. Use Claude or Codex for document, repository or test work when useful; inspect its output and record what you verified. Tool operation basics are self-study, not a substitute for the project work.

Client brief

Lead discovery for Purchasing Controls without a supplied question sequence. Identify decision owners, policy versions and integration dependencies. Pitch a complete proposal and defend architecture and full-cost assumptions.

Run of session

MinutesActivityInstructions
30PreparationRead the procurement client packet and the mapped official resources. Bring the previous decision record and identify the evidence you still need.
150Project workLead discovery for Purchasing Controls without a supplied question sequence. Identify decision owners, policy versions and integration dependencies. Pitch a complete proposal and defend architecture and full-cost assumptions.
45Apply feedback and constraintsRecheck scope, budget, permissions and evaluation after feedback. Compare the revised evidence with the agreed acceptance criteria.
15SubmissionSubmit decision-and-evidence.md: Approve the implementation scope, budget and acceptance criteria.; project-artefacts/: Project proposal, decision log, budget and acceptance plan.; revision-log.md: feedback, changes, evidence and individual contribution

Submission

  • decision-and-evidence.md: Approve the implementation scope, budget and acceptance criteria.
  • project-artefacts/: Project proposal, decision log, budget and acceptance plan.
  • revision-log.md: feedback, changes, evidence and individual contribution

Review criteria

  • Supports each decision with evidence and marks assumptions clearly.
  • Explains the impact on users, scope, full costs, controls and delivery.
  • Demonstrates the required work and identifies what was completed independently.

Decision to obtain

Approve the implementation scope, budget and acceptance criteria.

Knowledge check

What does proposal approval need?

  • Explicit scope, assumptions, budget, acceptance criteria and an accountable decision.
  • A working demo without an agreed budget.
  • A feature list approved by a user with no budget authority.
Answer and reasoning

Explicit scope, assumptions, budget, acceptance criteria and an accountable decision.

Explicit scope, assumptions, budget, acceptance criteria and an accountable decision. The decision must be supported by the project evidence.

Reference reasoning

Use the case constraints and policy owners as authority. Approve the implementation scope, budget and acceptance criteria. Inspect the supporting artefacts and unresolved issues before granting approval.

lessons.name: Enterprise Integration & Implementation
lessons.title: Enterprise Integration & Implementation
lessons.description: 工作坊：在已有代码、数据和接口中实现关键链路。处理最小权限、环境边界、重复事件和长任务，用运行证据检查接入。
lessons.description_en: Workshop: Implement against existing systems; handle least privilege, environment boundaries, duplicate events and long-running work.

learningMaterial.content:
Enterprise Integration & Implementation

在已有代码、数据和接口中实现关键链路。处理最小权限、环境边界、重复事件和长任务，用运行证据检查接入。

Preparation

Read the procurement client packet and the mapped official resources. Bring the previous decision record and identify the evidence you still need. Use Claude or Codex for document, repository or test work when useful; inspect its output and record what you verified. Tool operation basics are self-study, not a substitute for the project work.

Client brief

Implement the approved project using the provided interfaces. Reuse the service-event fixtures to test duplicate writes and partial integration failures; record environment, identity and recovery boundaries.

Run of session

MinutesActivityInstructions
15Decision and business contextAccept the integrated core flow for evaluation.
25Discovery and evidenceRead the procurement client packet and the mapped official resources. Bring the previous decision record and identify the evidence you still need.
35Independent client workImplement the approved project using the provided interfaces. Reuse the service-event fixtures to test duplicate writes and partial integration failures; record environment, identity and recovery boundaries.
60Implement and verifyProduce and verify: decision-and-evidence.md: Accept the integrated core flow for evaluation.; project-artefacts/: Working core flow, interface contracts and integration evidence.; revision-log.md: feedback, changes, evidence and individual contribution
30Review and next decisionPresent your work, respond to stakeholder questions and record the next decision: Accept the integrated core flow for evaluation.
15Revision planRecord feedback, individual contribution and the next validation.

Submission

  • decision-and-evidence.md: Accept the integrated core flow for evaluation.
  • project-artefacts/: Working core flow, interface contracts and integration evidence.
  • revision-log.md: feedback, changes, evidence and individual contribution

Review criteria

  • Supports each decision with evidence and marks assumptions clearly.
  • Explains the impact on users, scope, full costs, controls and delivery.
  • Demonstrates the required work and identifies what was completed independently.

Decision to obtain

Accept the integrated core flow for evaluation.

Knowledge check

How should repeated integration events be handled?

  • Use stable event identity and verify idempotent effects and recovery.
  • Retry every write without checking previous effects.
  • Use a new event identifier on every retry.
Answer and reasoning

Use stable event identity and verify idempotent effects and recovery.

Use stable event identity and verify idempotent effects and recovery. The decision must be supported by the project evidence.

Reference reasoning

Use the case constraints and policy owners as authority. Accept the integrated core flow for evaluation. Inspect the supporting artefacts and unresolved issues before granting approval.

lessons.title: Evaluation, Cost & Performance
lessons.description: 工作坊：验证 Agent 的权限、人工接管和失败恢复，核算质量、延迟、模型与复核成本，按失败证据调整实现。
lessons.description_en: Workshop: Evaluate bounded execution, human takeover and recovery; measure quality, latency and operating costs before changing the implementation.

learningMaterial.content:
Evaluation, Cost & Performance

验证 Agent 的权限、人工接管和失败恢复，核算质量、延迟、模型与复核成本，按失败证据调整实现。

Preparation

Read the procurement client packet and the mapped official resources. Bring the previous decision record and identify the evidence you still need. Use Claude or Codex for document, repository or test work when useful; inspect its output and record what you verified. Tool operation basics are self-study, not a substitute for the project work.

Client brief

Test bounded tools, approval expiry, human takeover and recovery after partial failure. Keep measured observations separate from estimates and recommend fixes based on quality, latency and complete operating costs.

Run of session

MinutesActivityInstructions
15Decision and business contextAccept the reliability controls and operating-cost assumptions.
15Discovery and evidenceRead the procurement client packet and the mapped official resources. Bring the previous decision record and identify the evidence you still need.
30Independent client workTest bounded tools, approval expiry, human takeover and recovery after partial failure. Keep measured observations separate from estimates and recommend fixes based on quality, latency and complete operating costs.
20Implement and verifyProduce and verify: decision-and-evidence.md: Accept the reliability controls and operating-cost assumptions.; project-artefacts/: Evaluation report, cost and performance evidence, recovery checks.; revision-log.md: feedback, changes, evidence and individual contribution
80Review and next decisionPresent your work, respond to stakeholder questions and record the next decision: Accept the reliability controls and operating-cost assumptions.
20Revision planRecord feedback, individual contribution and the next validation.

Submission

  • decision-and-evidence.md: Accept the reliability controls and operating-cost assumptions.
  • project-artefacts/: Evaluation report, cost and performance evidence, recovery checks.
  • revision-log.md: feedback, changes, evidence and individual contribution

Review criteria

  • Supports each decision with evidence and marks assumptions clearly.
  • Explains the impact on users, scope, full costs, controls and delivery.
  • Demonstrates the required work and identifies what was completed independently.

Decision to obtain

Accept the reliability controls and operating-cost assumptions.

Knowledge check

What demonstrates reliability?

  • Observed quality, failure handling, latency and cost against agreed criteria.
  • A successful run on one normal input.
  • A larger model selected without failure analysis.
Answer and reasoning

Observed quality, failure handling, latency and cost against agreed criteria.

Observed quality, failure handling, latency and cost against agreed criteria. The decision must be supported by the project evidence.

Reference reasoning

Use the case constraints and policy owners as authority. Accept the reliability controls and operating-cost assumptions. Inspect the supporting artefacts and unresolved issues before granting approval.

lessons.name: Stakeholder Management & Change Negotiation
lessons.title: Stakeholder Management & Change Negotiation
lessons.description: 工作坊：面对预算削减、接口延期或新增需求，和业务、IT、安全及预算负责人协商，重算范围、架构、费用与时间。
lessons.description_en: Workshop: Negotiate budget cuts, interface delays and added requirements; revise scope, architecture, cost and schedule.

learningMaterial.content:
Stakeholder Management & Change Negotiation

面对预算削减、接口延期或新增需求，和业务、IT、安全及预算负责人协商，重算范围、架构、费用与时间。

Preparation

Read the procurement client packet and the mapped official resources. Bring the previous decision record and identify the evidence you still need. Use Claude or Codex for document, repository or test work when useful; inspect its output and record what you verified. Tool operation basics are self-study, not a substitute for the project work.

Client brief

Apply the project change card. Negotiate competing stakeholder requests, revise the implementation and reusable workflow, recalculate costs and pitch the decision needed to proceed.

Run of session

MinutesActivityInstructions
15Decision and business contextApprove a revised scope and delivery plan.
25Discovery and evidenceRead the procurement client packet and the mapped official resources. Bring the previous decision record and identify the evidence you still need.
35Independent client workApply the project change card. Negotiate competing stakeholder requests, revise the implementation and reusable workflow, recalculate costs and pitch the decision needed to proceed.
60Implement and verifyProduce and verify: decision-and-evidence.md: Approve a revised scope and delivery plan.; project-artefacts/: Change request, impact analysis, revised proposal and decision log.; revision-log.md: feedback, changes, evidence and individual contribution
30Review and next decisionPresent your work, respond to stakeholder questions and record the next decision: Approve a revised scope and delivery plan.
15Revision planRecord feedback, individual contribution and the next validation.

Submission

  • decision-and-evidence.md: Approve a revised scope and delivery plan.
  • project-artefacts/: Change request, impact analysis, revised proposal and decision log.
  • revision-log.md: feedback, changes, evidence and individual contribution

Review criteria

  • Supports each decision with evidence and marks assumptions clearly.
  • Explains the impact on users, scope, full costs, controls and delivery.
  • Demonstrates the required work and identifies what was completed independently.

Decision to obtain

Approve a revised scope and delivery plan.

Knowledge check

What should happen after a budget cut?

  • Reassess scope, architecture, cost and time, then seek an explicit revised decision.
  • Keep the original scope and omit the cost change.
  • Silently remove controls to maintain the date.
Answer and reasoning

Reassess scope, architecture, cost and time, then seek an explicit revised decision.

Reassess scope, architecture, cost and time, then seek an explicit revised decision. The decision must be supported by the project evidence.

Reference reasoning

Use the case constraints and policy owners as authority. Approve a revised scope and delivery plan. Inspect the supporting artefacts and unresolved issues before granting approval.

lessons.description_en: Workshop: Use baselines and pilot evidence to decide investment; teach users to operate, review and recover the system.

learningMaterial.content:
Pilot Delivery & User Enablement

用基线、成功标准和试点证据判断投入。向用户讲解怎样操作、检查结果、处理异常，并验证回滚和维护责任。

Preparation

Read the procurement client packet and the mapped official resources. Bring the previous decision record and identify the evidence you still need. Use Claude or Codex for document, repository or test work when useful; inspect its output and record what you verified. Tool operation basics are self-study, not a substitute for the project work.

Client brief

Present pilot evidence against the agreed baseline. Run a user enablement session, ask the receiver to review an output and recover a failed task, and verify rollback and incident ownership.

Run of session

MinutesActivityInstructions
15Decision and business contextApprove wider adoption, a revised pilot or stopping.
25Discovery and evidenceRead the procurement client packet and the mapped official resources. Bring the previous decision record and identify the evidence you still need.
35Independent client workPresent pilot evidence against the agreed baseline. Run a user enablement session, ask the receiver to review an output and recover a failed task, and verify rollback and incident ownership.
60Implement and verifyProduce and verify: decision-and-evidence.md: Approve wider adoption, a revised pilot or stopping.; project-artefacts/: Pilot decision, user instructions, enablement and rollback plan.; revision-log.md: feedback, changes, evidence and individual contribution
30Review and next decisionPresent your work, respond to stakeholder questions and record the next decision: Approve wider adoption, a revised pilot or stopping.
15Revision planRecord feedback, individual contribution and the next validation.

Submission

  • decision-and-evidence.md: Approve wider adoption, a revised pilot or stopping.
  • project-artefacts/: Pilot decision, user instructions, enablement and rollback plan.
  • revision-log.md: feedback, changes, evidence and individual contribution

Review criteria

  • Supports each decision with evidence and marks assumptions clearly.
  • Explains the impact on users, scope, full costs, controls and delivery.
  • Demonstrates the required work and identifies what was completed independently.

Decision to obtain

Approve wider adoption, a revised pilot or stopping.

Knowledge check

What shows user enablement worked?

  • A user can review an output and handle an exception using the provided instructions.
  • An invitation sent to all intended users.
  • A slide presentation without any user practice.
Answer and reasoning

A user can review an output and handle an exception using the provided instructions.

A user can review an output and handle an exception using the provided instructions. The decision must be supported by the project evidence.

Reference reasoning

Use the case constraints and policy owners as authority. Approve wider adoption, a revised pilot or stopping. Inspect the supporting artefacts and unresolved issues before granting approval.

lessons.title: Acceptance, Handover & Final Pitch
lessons.description: 工作坊：对照最初承诺接受最终验收，接手者按资料独立运行和处理异常。每人解释自己的贡献、取舍与剩余问题。
lessons.description_en: Workshop: Defend acceptance evidence and individual decisions; let another participant operate and recover the project using the handover pack.

learningMaterial.content:
Acceptance, Handover & Final Pitch

对照最初承诺接受最终验收，接手者按资料独立运行和处理异常。每人解释自己的贡献、取舍与剩余问题。

Preparation

Read the procurement client packet and the mapped official resources. Bring the previous decision record and identify the evidence you still need. Use Claude or Codex for document, repository or test work when useful; inspect its output and record what you verified. Tool operation basics are self-study, not a substitute for the project work.

Client brief

Present the final project, costs and acceptance evidence. Give another participant the handover pack and observe an independent run and recovery. Explain your own contributions, unresolved risks and responsible owners.

Run of session

MinutesActivityInstructions
15Decision and business contextAccept delivery or identify the specific work that blocks acceptance.
15Discovery and evidenceRead the procurement client packet and the mapped official resources. Bring the previous decision record and identify the evidence you still need.
20Independent client workPresent the final project, costs and acceptance evidence. Give another participant the handover pack and observe an independent run and recovery. Explain your own contributions, unresolved risks and responsible owners.
60Implement and verifyProduce and verify: decision-and-evidence.md: Accept delivery or identify the specific work that blocks acceptance.; project-artefacts/: Final system, acceptance matrix, runbook, handover pack and pitch.; revision-log.md: feedback, changes, evidence and individual contribution
50Review and next decisionPresent your work, respond to stakeholder questions and record the next decision: Accept delivery or identify the specific work that blocks acceptance.
20Revision planRecord feedback, individual contribution and the next validation.

Submission

  • decision-and-evidence.md: Accept delivery or identify the specific work that blocks acceptance.
  • project-artefacts/: Final system, acceptance matrix, runbook, handover pack and pitch.
  • revision-log.md: feedback, changes, evidence and individual contribution

Review criteria

  • Supports each decision with evidence and marks assumptions clearly.
  • Explains the impact on users, scope, full costs, controls and delivery.
  • Demonstrates the required work and identifies what was completed independently.

Decision to obtain

Accept delivery or identify the specific work that blocks acceptance.

Knowledge check

What establishes handover readiness?

  • Another participant can run and recover the system using the handover pack.
  • The developer can run the system on their own machine.
  • The stakeholder signs the slides without checking operation.
Answer and reasoning

Another participant can run and recover the system using the handover pack.

Another participant can run and recover the system using the handover pack. The decision must be supported by the project evidence.

Acceptance, Handover & Final Pitch — Project Practice

对照最初承诺接受最终验收，接手者按资料独立运行和处理异常。每人解释自己的贡献、取舍与剩余问题。

Preparation

Read the procurement client packet and the mapped official resources. Bring the previous decision record and identify the evidence you still need. Use Claude or Codex for document, repository or test work when useful; inspect its output and record what you verified. Tool operation basics are self-study, not a substitute for the project work.

Client brief

Present the final project, costs and acceptance evidence. Give another participant the handover pack and observe an independent run and recovery. Explain your own contributions, unresolved risks and responsible owners.

Run of session

MinutesActivityInstructions

150Project workPresent the final project, costs and acceptance evidence. Give another participant the handover pack and observe an independent run and recovery. Explain your own contributions, unresolved risks and responsible owners.
45Apply feedback and constraintsRecheck scope, budget, permissions and evaluation after feedback. Compare the revised evidence with the agreed acceptance criteria.

Submission

  • decision-and-evidence.md: Accept delivery or identify the specific work that blocks acceptance.
  • project-artefacts/: Final system, acceptance matrix, runbook, handover pack and pitch.
  • revision-log.md: feedback, changes, evidence and individual contribution

Review criteria

  • Supports each decision with evidence and marks assumptions clearly.
  • Explains the impact on users, scope, full costs, controls and delivery.
  • Demonstrates the required work and identifies what was completed independently.

Decision to obtain

Accept delivery or identify the specific work that blocks acceptance.

Knowledge check

What establishes handover readiness?

  • Another participant can run and recover the system using the handover pack.
  • The developer can run the system on their own machine.
  • The stakeholder signs the slides without checking operation.
Answer and reasoning

Another participant can run and recover the system using the handover pack.
